boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: So what are your plans now?
entries.target: 那么你现在有什么打算？

entries.source: #Target# is returned to a much younger state!

Enemies are intimidated by your very presence.
		Enemies within radius %d have their Physical Power, Mindpower, and Spellpower reduced by %d.
		The power of the intimidation effect improves with your Physical power
entries.target:
敌人因你的存在而恐惧。
		半径 %d 码范围内的敌人的物理强度，精神强度和法术强度会降低 %d。
		受物理强度影响，威胁效果有加成。

entries.source:
Weave a net of arcane disturbances around your body, removing yourself from the sight of all, granting %d bonus to invisibility for 7 turns.
		While invisible all damage you deal against blinded or dazzled foes is increased by %d%% (additive with other damage increases).
		The invisibility bonus will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
你在身体周围编织一个奥术能量的干扰网，让你消失在敌人的视野中，获得 %d 强度的隐形效果，持续 7 回合。
		当隐形时，你对致盲或炫目的敌人造成的伤害增加 %d%% （与其他伤害加成效果加法叠加）
		隐形强度随法术强度提升。

entries.source: The wearer is treated as an undead.
entries.target: 装备者将被视为不死族。

entries.source: This ring shines with many colors.
entries.target: 这枚戒指闪耀着多种不同的色彩。

entries.source: A deep red light glows from within this damaged amulet of black stone. When you touch it, you can hear voices whispering within your mind.
entries.target: 从这条损坏的黑色项链上放出暗红色的光亮，当你触摸它时，你能听到脑海里的窃窃私语。

entries.source: fire a magical bolt dealing %d %s damage

Hexes your target and everything within a radius 2 ball around it. Each time they do damage, they take %d%% of the same damage for 20 turns.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
对目标施放邪术，诅咒目标和 2 码球形范围内的一切。每当目标造成伤害时，它们也会受到 %d%% 相同伤害，持续 20 回合。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Gain %d%% all damage and %d%% all res.
entries.target: 全体伤害增加 %d%%，全体伤害抗性增加 %d%%。

entries.source: %s fumbles and fails to use %s, injuring %s!
Reverts the minds of all creatures in a radius %d cone to an infantile state, in effect confusing them (%d%% to act randomly) for %d turns.
entries.target: 将半径 %d 格的锥形范围内所有生物的心智退回至婴儿状态，使其混乱（有 %d%% 的几率随机行动），持续 %d 回合。

entries.source:
No staff will save thee
Against the blindness of pride
Death will catch thee up
entries.target:
没有法杖能救汝
摆脱傲慢的蒙蔽
死亡终将追上汝

entries.source: A journal of the profits history of the Iron Throne dwarves.
entries.target: 有关钢铁王座矮人的盈利历史的记录。

entries.source: Here you are.  Just be sure not to get any on yourself!
entries.target: 给你。可千万小心别弄到自己身上！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* Yiilkgur the Sher'tul Fortress is a suitable location.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 夏·图尔堡垒伊克格是个合适的地方。#WHITE#

entries.source: The cultists are about to sacrifice the woman. Stop them!
entries.target: 邪教徒准备献祭那个女人。阻止他们！
%s勇敢地进入了一个夏·图尔传送门。

entries.source: Your melee and ranged attacks have a %d%% chance to shred enemies inflicting an additional 100%% of the damage dealt as a bleed over 4 turns.
entries.target: 你的近战和远程攻击有 %d%% 的几率撕裂敌人，使其在 4 回合内受到相当于本次伤害 100%% 的额外流血伤害。

entries.source: Some Time Elementals have been attracted by @Source@'s meddling.
entries.target: 由于@Source@的干预，一些时间元素被吸引而来。

entries.source: The blade glows faintly blue, and reflects a sky full of stormy clouds.
entries.target: 剑身泛着淡淡的蓝色，反射出了满天的乌云。

entries.source: Warriors from afar. They wield the power of light, and a mean sword.
entries.target: 来自远方的战士。他们擅长光魔法和华丽的剑技。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Archery range and speed#LAST#
Archery attacks create projectiles with a maximum range, beyond which they will terminate.
The projectiles travel at their own speed, measured as a percentage (higher, usually) of normal movement speed.
entries.target:
#GOLD#弓箭范围和速度#LAST#
弓箭能射出的最大范围，超过范围攻击会消失。
所有抛射物有独立的飞行速度，以百分比形式和移动速度比较。

entries.source:
Detects traps.
Removes (25%% chance) up to three stuns, pins, or dazes each turn%s
entries.target:
侦查陷阱。
25%%几率解除至多3个震慑、定身或眩晕效果。%s

entries.source: I am not a tool! RELEASE ME!
entries.target: 我不是你的工具！放开我！

entries.source: Teleports up to five targets in a radius of %d up to ten tiles away.
entries.target: 将半径 %d 范围内最多五个单位传送到十格以内。

entries.source:
Tries to perform a killing blow, doing %d%% weapon damage and dealing an automatic critical hit. If the target ends up with low enough life (<20%%), it might be instantly killed.
		At level 4, it drains half your remaining stamina, and uses it to increase the blow damage by 100%% of it.
		The chance to instantly kill will increase with your Physical Power.
entries.target:
试图施展一次致命打击，造成 %d%% 武器伤害，本次攻击自动变成暴击。
		如果打击后目标生命值低于 20%% 则有可能直接杀死。
		在等级 4 时会消耗剩余的耐力值的一半并增加 100%% 所消耗耐力值的伤害。
		目标即死的概率受物理强度加成。

entries.source: All creature talent levels increased by 170%
entries.target: 所有生物技能等级增加 170%

entries.source:
#GOLD#Status resistance#LAST#
Most bad status effects can be avoided by having an appropriate immunity, represented by a percent chance to completely avoid the effect in question.  This chance is applied in addition to any saving throws or other checks that may apply.
entries.target:
#GOLD#状态免疫#LAST#
大部分状态效果可以被特定的免疫来抵消，以百分比表示你完全免疫该效果的几率。这一几率会与任何适用的豁免或其他判定叠加计算。

entries.source: The Eidolon Plane seems not to physically exist in the same way the normal world does. You cannot seem to drop anything here. %s comes back into your backpack.
entries.target: 艾德隆位面似乎并不像现实世界一样真实存在，你在这里似乎不能丢弃任何东西，%s 又回到了你的手中。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Necrotic Aura#LAST#
Represents the raw materials for creating undead minions.
It increases each time you or your minions kill something that is inside the aura radius.
entries.target:
#GOLD#死灵光环#LAST#
代表召唤死灵生物的原材料。
光环内的死灵随从每次杀死生物时会增加灵魂值。

entries.source:
Well, if you insist...
I am a novice mage, as you might have noticed, and my goal is to be accepted by the people of Angolwen and be taught the secrets of the arcane.
entries.target:
好吧，假如你坚持的话……
我是个法师学徒，你可能已经看出来了。我的目标是得到安格利文人的接纳，向他们学习奥术的秘密。

entries.source: Perhaps there's something that I can help you with.

Bind the target mercilessly with constant, bone-shattering pressure, pinning and slowing it by 50%% for %d turns and dealing %0.1f Physical damage each turn.
		The duration and damage improve with Mindpower.
entries.target:
用粉碎骨头的力量紧紧锁住目标，定身并减速目标 50%%，持续 %d 回合，每回合造成 %0.1f 物理伤害。
		持续时间和伤害受精神强度加成。

entries.source:
#{italic}#68th of Dusk, Year of Pyre 710#{normal}#
The orcish tribe have routed us. We have retreated to some Mardrop ruins and secured ourselves amongst the fortifications. I have just shy of 2,000 men under my banner, some of the best warriors I have ever served with, but we are simply no match for the numbers we face. Counting them is difficult, but I would put a minimum estimate at 10,000. The tribe has camped a league away - they seem to be waiting for reinforcements. This does not bode well...

I have sent messenger crows to all the kingdoms. I can but hope they send aid in time.
entries.target:
#{italic}#烈火纪710年，黄昏月68日#{normal}#
兽人部落击溃了我们。我们已退至马卓普的一处遗迹，依托其中的工事据守。我麾下不足两千人，其中不乏我并肩作战过的最出色战士，可面对如此数量的敌人，我们实在无力匹敌。敌军难以清点，但至少有一万。兽人部落在一里格之外扎下营寨——他们似乎正在等待增援。这可不是好兆头……

我已派信鸦前往所有王国。只盼他们的援军能及时赶到。

entries.source: You do not have the summoning scroll!

entries.target: 不行，我们必须得抓紧时间！
